name: miadi-mentorship
description: Draft. A seat that mentors another user's session on the same host: it reads the mentee's hook capture, supplies what is useful to the relationship, steers only after a person's go and a clear pane guard, and keeps the mentee's words verbatim. Each step is a CloudEvents 1.0 event appended to a local log and, when MIADI_MENTORSHIP_WEBHOOK_URL is set, POSTed to that webhook. mentee-watch turns the mentee's capture into mentee.said and mentee.turn_ended with ids, counts and times only, never the mentee's words unless --with-text is given. The mentorship skill says what the seat does at each step and which event it emits.
